statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-105544 is a .NET elevation of privilege issue in VSTest: its artifact postprocessor can consume a forged executionComplete.json written by another local user and run attacker-controlled output handling. Microsoft lists the VSTest runner bundled in .NET SDK 10.0.100 through 10.0.114 as affected and SDK 10.0.115, which bundles VSTest 18.0.2-hotfix-26529-108, as fixed, together with the Microsoft.TestPlatform.CLI package (https://github.com/dotnet/announcements/issues/517, https://github.com/microsoft/vstest/issues/16654, https://github.com/dotnet/core/blob/main/release-notes/10.0/10.0.15/10.0.15.md). DHI dotnet10-runtime for Alpine 3.24 builds .NET 10 for Linux from Microsoft's dotnet/dotnet source release, and each build's version is the .NET release it carries; 10.0.15-r0 is built from the v10.0.115 source tag (https://github.com/dotnet/dotnet/releases/tag/v10.0.115). Checked the seven published builds (10.0.8-r0, 10.0.9-r0, 10.0.10-r0, 10.0.12-r0, 10.0.13-r0, 10.0.14-r0 and 10.0.15-r0) for x86_64 and aarch64, including the files inside their nupkg and tar.gz archives: the .NET SDK in dotnet10-runtime-bootstrap is the SDK of each build's .NET release, from SDK 10.0.108 in 10.0.8-r0 through SDK 10.0.114 in 10.0.14-r0 and SDK 10.0.115 in 10.0.15-r0. Its bundled VSTest runner and the Microsoft.TestPlatform.CLI NuGet package in dotnet10-runtime-artifacts are 18.0.2-release builds in the earlier builds and 18.0.2-hotfix-26529-108 (file version 18.0.226.53008) in 10.0.15-r0. The range ends at 10.0.15-r0 because it is the first published build with the fix.

CVE-2026-105544 is a .NET elevation of privilege issue in the VSTest test platform: its artifact post-processor can consume a forged executionComplete.json written by another local user and run attacker-controlled output handling. VSTest is bundled in the .NET SDK, and Microsoft lists .NET SDK 8.0.1xx from 8.0.100 through 8.0.133 as affected and 8.0.134, which bundles VSTest 17.8.1-hotfix-26528-33, as fixed (https://github.com/dotnet/announcements/issues/517, https://github.com/dotnet/core/blob/main/release-notes/8.0/8.0.34/8.0.34.md). DHI dotnet8-runtime for Alpine 3.23 builds .NET 8 for Linux from Microsoft's source release, and each build's version is the .NET runtime version it carries. Scanned all 220 packages of the ten published builds (8.0.23-r0, 8.0.24-r0, 8.0.25-r0, 8.0.26-r0, 8.0.27-r0, 8.0.29-r0, 8.0.31-r0, 8.0.32-r0, 8.0.33-r0 and 8.0.34-r0) for x86_64 and aarch64, including the files inside their nupkg archives. VSTest is present in two places in every build: the .NET SDK held by dotnet8-runtime-bootstrap, and the Microsoft.TestPlatform.CLI and Microsoft.TestPlatform.Build NuGet packages in dotnet8-runtime-artifacts. In 8.0.23-r0 through 8.0.33-r0 the bootstrap package holds .NET SDK 8.0.123 through 8.0.133, matching each build's .NET 8 release, and both locations carry VSTest 17.8.0-release-23615-02, the test platform bundled with those affected SDKs. In 8.0.34-r0 the bootstrap package holds .NET SDK 8.0.134 and both locations carry VSTest 17.8.1-hotfix-26528-33, on both architectures; no other VSTest version is present. The range ends at 8.0.34-r0 because it is the first published build with the fix.

CVE-2026-105544 is a .NET elevation of privilege issue in the VSTest test runner: its artifact postprocessor can consume a forged executionComplete.json written by another local user and run attacker-controlled output handling. The VSTest CLI ships inside the .NET SDK, and Microsoft fixed .NET SDK 9.0.1xx in 9.0.124, which bundles VSTest 17.12.1-hotfix-26528-39 (https://github.com/dotnet/announcements/issues/517, https://github.com/microsoft/vstest/issues/16654, https://github.com/dotnet/core/blob/main/release-notes/9.0/9.0.23/9.0.23.md). DHI dotnet9-runtime for Alpine 3.23 builds .NET 9 for Linux from Microsoft's source release, and each build's version is the .NET runtime version it carries; 9.0.23-r0 is built from the dotnet/dotnet v9.0.124 source tag (https://github.com/dotnet/dotnet/releases/tag/v9.0.124), and its assemblies record that tag's commit, f4699d9. Scanned all 242 packages of the eleven published builds (9.0.12-r0, 9.0.13-r0, 9.0.14-r0, 9.0.15-r0, 9.0.16-r0, 9.0.17-r0, 9.0.18-r0, 9.0.20-r0, 9.0.21-r0, 9.0.22-r0 and 9.0.23-r0) for x86_64 and aarch64, including the files inside the nupkg and other zip archives they hold: every build carries vstest.console.dll in the .NET SDK held by dotnet9-runtime-bootstrap and the Microsoft.TestPlatform.CLI NuGet package in dotnet9-runtime-artifacts. In 9.0.12-r0 through 9.0.22-r0 (.NET SDK 9.0.113 through 9.0.123) both copies are VSTest 17.12.0-release-24508-01, and in both 9.0.23-r0 builds (.NET SDK 9.0.124) both are 17.12.1-hotfix-26528-39. The range ends at 9.0.23-r0 because it is the first published build with the fix.
